title: Recursive formula for biased probability
statement: For any real bias parameter $\rho$, any nonnegative integer $m$, and any predicate $A$ on Boolean strings, its biased probability on strings of length $m+1$ is $\rho$ times the biased probability of the predicate obtained by prepending true to strings of length $m$, plus $1-\rho$ times the biased probability of the predicate obtained by prepending false.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a predicate on Boolean strings
